label: Import Contacts

details: Implemented EditContactModal with PUT /api/contacts/[id] and field validation.

details: Connected to DELETE /api/contacts/[id] with confirmation and toast notification.

label: + Add Contact
details: Implemented ManualAddContactModal with phone validation and list assignment.

details: Connected to POST /api/contacts/lists with name uniqueness handling.

label: Add to Blacklist
details: Connected to POST /api/contacts/blacklist with reason and automatic broadcast filtering.

label: Create Template
details: Implemented CreateTemplateModal with POST /api/templates and live preview.

details: Implemented DELETE /api/templates/[id] route handler.

details: Preloads template and switches to Campaign Wizard.

label: Conversation Thread Selector
details: Implemented missing GET /api/replies/[id] route handler returning unified message thread.

details: Implemented missing POST /api/replies/[id]/send route handler dispatching through Evolution API.

label: Sync Live Chats
details: Connected to POST /api/replies with active instance connection status check.

details: Connected to POST /api/evolution/instances with live QR trigger.

details: Opens QRCodeModal with real-time polling until connection state turns OPEN.

label: Refresh Instances
details: Actively probes Evolution connectionState so instances never falsely show Offline.

label: Launch Campaign
details: Validates audience, rotation parameters, and dispatches to queue with loading state.
